annotation.title_clean: Mind (and) the Robot: On the Epistemology and Ethics of the Attribution of Mental States to Robots
annotation.title_en: Mind (and) the Robot: On the Epistemology and Ethics of the Attribution of Mental States to Robots
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Larghi, S.; Datteri, E.; Zanotti, G.; Facchin, M.; Alfieri, I.; Raffa, M.; et al.
annotation.venue: Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence and Applications, Vol. 397: Social Robots with AI (IOS Press)
annotation.summary_en: Abstract of a philosophical panel on attributing mental states and cognition to social robots, covering epistemological, ethical and design dimensions: modelling robot minds, emotion attribution, decision-making in social assistive robotics, and enactive intentionality in human-robot interaction. It is not a governance instrument.
key_provisions_or_claims: Panel examines styles of modelling robots' minds.
Emotion attribution to robots shapes interaction with social robots.
Ethical implications of decision-making in social assistive robotics.
Enactive intentionality informs HRI understanding and robot interface design.
